ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the life cycle shown to us, what stage comes after pupa?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image shows the life cycle of a butterfly. Position A is a leaf, with an egg on it; the arrow points from A to B, B is a caterpillar/larva; the arrow points from B to C, C is a green pupa/chrysalis; the arrow points from C to D, D is a butterfly; then the arrow goes from D back to A. Then reason: the question asks what stage is after pupa. In the image, the pupa corresponds to C; following the arrow from C to the next stage, it points to the butterfly at D. The butterfly is the adult stage, so after the pupa is adult.
